title: X-ray radiography - overview
description: Modality (overview): X-ray radiography - ionizing electromagnetic radiation projected through tissue onto a detector. Discovered by Wilhelm Rontgen in 1895; first Nobel Prize in Physics 1901.
principle: ionizing electromagnetic radiation projected through tissue onto a detector
contraindications: pregnancy without justification for ionizing modalities
annotation_guidelines: Label anatomy, mark findings with standard terms, and record acquisition parameters.
performance_notes: Reference teaching notes; not measured clinical performance.
privacy_note: Reference record. Contains no real patient data and no protected health information.
